query:
WITH BachelorGraduates AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(university_name) AS university_name,
    id,
    DATEDIFF(graduation_date, enrollment_date) AS days_to_graduate
  FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala
  WHERE TRIM(qualification) = 'بكالوريوس'
    AND graduation_date IS NOT NULL
    AND enrollment_date IS NOT NULL
    AND DATEDIFF(graduation_date, enrollment_date) BETWEEN 365 AND 3650
    AND TRIM(university_name) NOT IN ('المؤسسة العامة للتدريب التقني والمهني', 'الكلية التقنية', 'المعهد التقني')
)
SELECT 
  university_name,
  ROUND(AVG(days_to_graduate)) AS avg_days_to_graduate,
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS graduate_count
FROM BachelorGraduates
GROUP BY university_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) >= 10
ORDER BY avg_days_to_graduate ASC
LIMIT 5
